summary: Braemar Hotels & Resorts Inc. filed an 8-K reporting two divestiture transactions. On July 14, 2026, its indirect subsidiaries completed the sale of three properties—The Ritz-Carlton Sarasota, Hotel Yountville, and Bardessono Hotel and Spa—for $437.5 million in cash. On July 13, 2026, it entered an agreement to sell the Pier House Resort & Spa in Key West for $190.0 million, with closing subject to conditions. No premium, board recommendation, or advisor was disclosed. The sales reduce portfolio exposure; risk-arb watching remaining closing conditions and use of proceeds for debt paydown or shareholder returns.
